subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming progress policy, change non-zero exec progress wording globally, or only receive a narrower channel-specific hide-progress toggle?
rationale: The report is valid at source level, but the durable fix can add config surface and change cross-channel semantics for non-zero exec exits, both of which need product and compatibility judgment.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu progress config
options.body: Add Feishu support for the shared `streaming.progress.toolProgress` style policy, preserve the existing boolean config with an explicit migration or compatibility plan, and add Feishu tests/docs.

options.title: Change exec wording globally
options.body: Keep Feishu config unchanged and adjust shared progress/error presentation so completed non-zero exec results show exit status without implying task failure.

options.title: Ship a narrow Feishu toggle
options.body: Add a Feishu-only hide-progress setting while leaving broader exec failure semantics and shared streaming config alignment for later.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu progress config
recommendation.body: Add Feishu support for the shared `streaming.progress.toolProgress` style policy, preserve the existing boolean config with an explicit migration or compatibility plan, and add Feishu tests/docs.

likelyOwner.reason: The current blame and recent merged PR history tie this handle to the inspected Feishu and shared progress/error paths most directly affected by the decision.
